question.html:
White light is passed through a gas. The light beam that emerges from the gas is passed through a prism and projected onto a screen.

What is the name of the pattern that is formed on the screen and what information can be deduced about the gas based on this pattern?

Name of the pattern that is formed on the screen

Information that can be deduced about the gas

A.

Absorption spectrum

The temperature of the gas

B.

Absorption spectrum

The chemical composition of the gas

C.

Emission spectrum

The temperature of the gas

D.

Emission spectrum

The chemical composition of the gas
